killedBy: a versus recording says how many slots the computer drives (issue #359) puts `bots` after `players`, because it is bounded by it
why: Validates the bot count and then never asks the page for it. A versus flow whose `bots` is dropped fills every slot with a human nobody is driving, so the recording is tanks sitting still -- and it is worse than no evidence, because the report still names the session that was requested. The failure is silent by construction: the recorder checks that the round is playing and that the stock strip is up, both of which are true of a board full of idle tanks.
